name: Cajuns (Acadiana, Louisiana, United States)
description: A white triangle at the hoist bears a gold star; the fly is divided horizontally, navy blue above with three white fleurs-de-lis and red below with a gold castle.
history: The flag of Acadiana was designed by Thomas J. Arceneaux in 1965 and recognised by the Louisiana legislature in 1974 as the flag of the Acadiana region. The fleurs-de-lis stand for the French heritage, the castle for the Spanish rule under which the Acadians settled Louisiana, and the star for Our Lady of the Assumption, patron of the Acadians.
